difficulty_reason: Presheaf-base variant of lemma-injective-trivial-cech: by equation-identify-cech we have s(F(K)) = Hom(s(Z_{F(K)}^#), F); lemma-acyclic-hypercover-sheaves makes s(Z_{F(K)}^#) quasi-isomorphic to Z_G^#; injectivity of I then gives that s(I(K)) is acyclic in positive degrees, so Cech^i(K,I) = 0 for i > 0; degree 0 is lemma-h0-cech-variant.
